lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: input output and notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

steps: Substitute x = 5 into the rule: f(5) = 3(5) + 4.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 11x + 5, find the value of x for which f(x) = 49.

Function A is given by f(x) = -10x - 14. Function B is given by the table:
x: 1, 2
y: 23, 21
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
They have the same rate of change.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = 7x. Function A starts at 29 and increases by 11 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 2?
choices: Cannot be determined without a graph.
The two functions have equal values at that input.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: -3, 0, 3, 6
y: -13, -1, 11, 23
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
choices: cannot be determined from a table

items.prompt: Classify the equation y = 7x + 17 as linear or nonlinear.
choices: cannot be determined from an equation

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: A function contains the points (-3, -2) and (-6, -20). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A gym charges a $101 sign-up fee plus $14 per month. Which function models the total cost f(x) after x months?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A kettle of water heats up steadily, then boils at a constant temperature, then cools steadily once removed from heat. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
